headline: Base Lines Shift on Four Active Fronts
war_summary: Since the previous return, the sharpest ownership change is in Linn’s Mercy: the tally now stands at seven Colonial, three Warden and one neutral base, with 42 event rows in the past day and ten in the latest two hours. Weathered Expanse has moved to five Colonial, one Warden and three neutral bases; its 45 rows include four in the latest two hours. Nevish Line now has five Colonial, two Warden and one neutral base, with six recent rows. Mooring County remains eleven Warden to one Colonial, though its record shows 19 rows in the past day and three in the latest two hours. Marban Hollow has logged eleven rows, all within the latest two hours, and remains divided among four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral base. Callahan’s Passage is now wholly Warden-held, ten bases to none, after nine rows in the past day, but none in the latest two hours. Stonecradle’s 1–8 Warden-Colonial balance is unchanged and its event record has gone quiet since yesterday evening. The war remains unresolved; 34 victory towns are required.
